complexity.notes: The best_buy variable is dead code: it is updated but never used, since the inner loop compares against prices[i] rather than the running minimum. A single pass tracking min price so far would achieve O(n) time; as written this is correct but quadratic.
complexity.summary: Brute-force check of every (buy, sell) pair with i < j, tracking the maximum profit; initializes the answer to 0 so unprofitable inputs correctly return 0.
